senses.label: Serving of wine
senses.meaning: a serving of wine
examples: I'd like three beers and two wines, please. My friend will have the same.

senses.label: Appendage of an animal's
senses.meaning: an appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly
examples: The bird was flapping its wings.

senses.label: Part of an aircraft
senses.meaning: part of an aircraft that produces the lift for rising into the air
examples: I took my seat on the plane, overlooking the wing.

senses.label: A part
senses.meaning: a part of something that is lesser in size than the main body, and located at the side
examples: The west wing of the hospital.

senses.label: Adjective
senses.meaning: showing good judgement or the benefit of experience
examples: Storing extra food for the winter was a wise decision.
They were considered the wise old men of the administration.

senses.label: Aware or informed
senses.meaning: aware, informed (to something)
examples: Be careful: the boss is wise to your plan to call out sick.

senses.label: Desire or hope
senses.meaning: a desire, hope, or longing for something or for something to happen
examples: It is my wish that the bequest (should) be given to an almshouse.

senses.label: Thing desired or longed
senses.meaning: the thing desired or longed for
examples: My dearest wish is to see them happily married.

senses.label: Desire or want
senses.meaning: to desire, to want
examples: I'll come tomorrow, if you wish (it).
I wish it to be known that I wish them all to leave the company.
Anyone who wishes an aisle seat should see an attendant.

senses.label: Noun
senses.meaning: attestation of a fact or event, testimony
examples: She can bear witness, since she was there at the time.

senses.label: Noun
senses.meaning: one who sees or has personal knowledge of something
examples: As a witness to the event, I can confirm that he really said that.

senses.label: Someone called
senses.meaning: someone called to give evidence in a court
examples: The witness for the prosecution did not seem very credible.

senses.label: Adult female human
senses.meaning: an adult female human
examples: The first woman president of Spain.

senses.label: All female humans collectively
senses.meaning: all female humans collectively, womankind
examples: Unsurprisingly, if modern man is a sort of camera, modern woman is a picture.
For if modern woman is so intent on keeping her surname alive, why not demand it be passed along to her children?

senses.label: Female person
senses.meaning: a female person, usually an adult: a (generally adult) female sentient being, whether human, supernatural, elf, alien, etc
examples: Sir, have you ever served with any Bajoran women?
One of the elves, a woman with long auburn hair, was garbed identically to the two dwarves.
To be born a woman has been to be born, within an allotted and confined space, into the keeping of men.

senses.label: Noun
senses.meaning: something that causes amazement or awe, a marvel
examples: Wonders of the World seem to come in sevens.

senses.label: Astonishing and seemingly inexplicable turn
senses.meaning: an astonishing and seemingly inexplicable turn of events
examples: The idea was so ridiculous that it's a wonder anyone went along with it.

senses.label: Noun
senses.meaning: a feat that demonstrates incredible finesse or skill, as if performed by magic
examples: Given the limited resources, he's really performed wonders.

senses.label: Tending to excite wonder
senses.meaning: tending to excite wonder, surprising, extraordinary
examples: His delusion was not wonderful, but most natural.

senses.label: Surprisingly excellent
senses.meaning: surprisingly excellent, very good or admirable, extremely impressive
examples: They served a wonderful six-course meal.
What appears to be wonderful may turn out to be anything but.

senses.label: Forested or wooded area
senses.meaning: a forested or wooded area
examples: A wood beyond this moor was viewed as a border area in the seventeenth century.
He got lost in the woods beyond Seattle.

senses.label: Angry debate or conversation
senses.meaning: angry debate or conversation, argument
examples: After she found out the truth, she had words with him, to tell him how she felt.

senses.label: Lines in a script
senses.meaning: the lines in a script for a performance
examples: You better get your words memorised before rehearsal next Sat.

senses.label: Incidental or subsidiary calculations performed
senses.meaning: the incidental or subsidiary calculations performed in solving an overall problem
examples: Be sure to check your working.

senses.label: Adjective
senses.meaning: that suffices but requires additional work, provisional
examples: A working copy of the script.

senses.label: Enough to allow
senses.meaning: enough to allow one to use something
examples: Have a working knowledge of computers.

senses.label: Factory or factories
senses.meaning: a factory or factories, or a similar collection(s) of industrial facilities
examples: The steel works almost fills the valley.

senses.label: Mechanism or machinery
senses.meaning: a mechanism or machinery, the means by which something happens
examples: Aged and degraded oil and grease can really gum up the works.

senses.label: Everything or everything
senses.meaning: everything or everything that is available or possible, especially, all available toppings on food
examples: I'll have a Behemoth Burger with the works.

senses.label: Thinking about unpleasant things
senses.meaning: thinking about unpleasant things that have happened or that might happen, feeling afraid and unhappy
examples: She was worried about her son who had been sent off to fight in the war.

senses.label: Afflicted with or marked
senses.meaning: afflicted with or marked by anxious uneasiness or trouble or grief
examples: One last worried check of the sleeping children.

senses.label: Disturb the peace
senses.meaning: disturb the peace of mind of, afflict with mental agitation or distress, to exercise
examples: Your tone of voice worries me.

senses.label: To harass
senses.meaning: to harass, to irritate or distress
examples: The President was worried into military action by persistent advisors.

senses.label: Seize or shake
senses.meaning: to seize or shake by the throat, especially of a dog or wolf
examples: Your dog's been worrying sheep again.

senses.label: More severely or seriously
senses.meaning: more severely or seriously
examples: The bad news affected me worse than it did my brother.

senses.label: Adverb
senses.meaning: used to start a sentence describing something that is worse
examples: Her leg is infected. Still worse, she's developing a fever.

senses.label: That which is worse
senses.meaning: that which is worse, something less good
examples: Do not think the worse of him for his enterprise.

senses.label: Most inferior
senses.meaning: most inferior, doing the least good
examples: I think putting oil on a burn is the worst thing you can do.

senses.label: Most harmful or severe
senses.meaning: most harmful or severe
examples: The worst storm we had last winter knocked down our power lines.

senses.label: Adjective
senses.meaning: used with the definite article and an implied noun: something that is worst
examples: None of these photographs of me are good, but this one is definitely the worst.

senses.label: Having a value
senses.meaning: having a value of, proper to be exchanged for
examples: Cleanliness is a virtue worth more than others.
A painting once thought to be worth thousands that is actually not worth much.
Is it well worth visiting your hometown? -Nah, Leicester is not worth it at all.

senses.label: Making a fair equivalent
senses.meaning: making a fair equivalent of, repaying or compensating
examples: This job is hardly worth the effort.

senses.label: Form letters
senses.meaning: to form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate
examples: The pupil wrote his name on the paper.
Your son has been writing on the wall.

senses.label: Be the author
senses.meaning: to be the author of (a book, article, poem, etc.)
examples: My uncle writes newspaper articles for The Herald.

senses.label: Compose and send written information
senses.meaning: to compose and send written information (to)
examples: Please write to me when you get there.
Please write me when you get there.
He never phones me, but he does write occasionally.

senses.label: Person who writes
senses.meaning: a person who writes, or produces literary work, an author can refer to themselves as "the writer"
examples: Has your girlfriend written you another letter already? She's quite a writer!
I met some of my favourite authors at the writers' convention.
The present writer (referring to oneself as the writer).

senses.label: Asserting something incorrect or untrue
senses.meaning: asserting something incorrect or untrue
examples: You're wrong: he's not Superman at all.

senses.label: Adjective
senses.meaning: immoral, not good, bad
examples: Shepard: Some part of you must still realize this is wrong. You can fight this!

senses.label: Not working
senses.meaning: not working, out of order
examples: Something is wrong with my cellphone.
Don't cry, honey. Tell me what's wrong.

senses.label: Day immediately before today
senses.meaning: the day immediately before today, one day ago
examples: Today is the child of yesterday and the parent of tomorrow.
Yesterday was rainy, but by this morning it had begun to snow.

senses.label: The past
senses.meaning: the past, often in terms of being outdated
examples: The worker of today is different from that of yesterday.

senses.label: On the day before today
senses.meaning: on the day before today
examples: I started to watch the video yesterday, but could only finish it this evening.

senses.label: In the early part
senses.meaning: in the early part of growth or life, born not long ago
examples: A lamb is a young sheep.
These picture books are for young readers.
Come skydiving with us. Come on, you're only young once!

senses.label: At an early stage
senses.meaning: at an early stage of existence or development, having recently come into existence
examples: The age of space travel is still young.

senses.label: Adjective
senses.meaning: early (of a decade of life)
examples: Ephraim would be in his young thirties.

senses.label: Who is younger than another
senses.meaning: one who is younger than another
examples: Youngers did not like olders to be mean and bossy.
There are the usual tensions between elders and middles, and between middles and youngers.

senses.label: Quality or state
senses.meaning: the quality or state of being young
examples: Her youth and beauty attracted him to her.

senses.label: Part of life following childhood
senses.meaning: the part of life following childhood, the period of existence preceding maturity or age, the whole early part of life, from childhood, or, sometimes
examples: Make the most of your youth, it will not last forever.
I made many mistakes in my youth, but learned from them all.

senses.label: Numeric symbol
senses.meaning: the numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero
examples: In unary and k-adic notation in general, zero is the empty string.
The zero sign in American Sign Language is considered rude in some cultures.

senses.label: Value of a magnitude corresponding
senses.meaning: the value of a magnitude corresponding to the cardinal number zero
examples: The electromagnetic field does not drop all of the way to zero before a reversal.

senses.label: Point on a scale
senses.meaning: the point on a scale at which numbering or measurement originates
examples: The temperature outside is ten degrees below zero.

senses.label: Given area distinguished
senses.meaning: a given area distinguished on the basis of a particular characteristic, use, restriction, etc
examples: The white zone is for loading and unloading only.
Files in the Internet zone are blocked by default, as a security measure.

senses.label: Restricted category or virtual place
senses.meaning: a restricted category or virtual place
examples: The discussion was veering off into a danger zone.

senses.label: Band or area
senses.meaning: a band or area of growth encircling anything
examples: A zone of evergreens on a mountain.
The zone of animal or vegetable life in the ocean around an island or a continent.
